name: Distro 10 - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Cherry Swirl
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Distro 10 Cherry Swirl pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Built on the Cherry Sizzle strain, Cherry Swirl delivers a rich, fruit-forward profile: ripe, juicy cherry up front with a sweet candy edge, rounded out by a smooth, subtly gassy finish. It's a flavorful, easygoing smoke made for anyone who likes their sessions sweet, bold, and full of taste.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Cherry Sizzle strain — ripe cherry sweetness with a smooth, gassy backbone
Bold Cherry Swirl flavor — sweet, juicy cherry with a candy-like finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Distro 10 Cherry Swirl is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
